entry.title: Tomba! v0.0.1
entry.content:
Second **alpha release** introducing various bug fixes and improvements regarding Archipelago synchronization.
> [!WARNING] > This release is in an early testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.
---
## ✨ What's New
### 🛠️ Stability & Softlock Fixes * Rewrote the game interface assembly in order to pop found items from the game only when they have successfully been processed * Added some more info in the README section * Fix #6 : Added Section information on Leaf Butterflies and changed numerotation * Fix #10 : Added a threshold so location that are too far are not checked * Fixed the Pipe location: The actual item is not required by the game logic so the location can stay without creating a softlock in Baccus Lake * Fixed Healing mushroom not being harvestable * Fixed the Mermaid's Singing Rock logic to require a weapon of sort * Typo in the Motocross section * Fixed filler items now also giving Lunch Box, Large Lunch Box and Healing Mushroom * Fixed chest in stormy mountains not respawning if not having grabbed the two wings * Fix #7 : Manualy trigger the Telescope location upon completing the event as it becomes unpickable once the Look and See!? event is cleared * Fix: Look and See event was reported accessible without Telescope in the inventory * Fix #8 : Baron is no longer randomized as it breaks related events * Changes the location/item association algorithm, location that do not have coordinates are prioritized * Added regression tests * Fix #15 * Fix #13 * Fix Softlock with the phoenix if phoenix mountain event is cleared * Fix #17 : Uses The Real Evil Pig event instead of Grandpa's Bracelet which is unreliable due to appearing much later in the cutscene * Fix #18 : Introducing door manipulation (thanks to bosshunter on Discord) to force Baccus Village accessible once Phoenix Mountain is cleared and starting the Mouse Pig Bag event in order to avoid Softlock * Fix #14: Verified the item counts and added locations * Fix entering Hidden Village with Grapple or GrappleJack * Fix #16 : Pants can now be grabbed and the locations are associated correctly regardless of the current pants Tomba owns * Fix Flower Seeds not being in logic before forest is cleared * And probably many other issues I forgot to track
### 🚫 Non-Randomized Elements To preserve game stability, the following elements remain in their vanilla states and are **not randomized**: * The **Furious Tornado** on the mailbox. * The **Frog** required for the *Take Me Home* event. * **Healing Mushroom** and **Blue Powder** are no longer randomized
---
## 🔧 Installation 1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file. 2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.

entry.title: CrossCode v0.9.5
entry.content:
## Changes to Logic
* Modified **Faj'ro Temple** and **Grand Krys'kajo** logic (#90, @Valkhiya). * Both temples now have their initial doors leading to the middle of the temple unlocked by default. * Now, completing the left and right branches of the first floor of each temple, instead of unlocking the next part of the dungeon, spawns a chest. * This relaxes the number of required elements needed to finish these temples, leading to more possible logical permutations. * **Note:** These patches are not applied conditionally. If you generated on 0.9.4 or before and you want to avoid going out of logic, you will have to enforce this on your own by only accessing the second floor of the dungeons only after completing both branches. * Removed Chest Lock Randomization from **Mine U2: Frozen Chamber 2 Right**, **Faj'ro 3F: Large Fire Chamber Right**, and **So'najiz U1: Trial of Persistence Lower Left** (#91, @CodeTriangle). * These chests are the game's introduction to the concept of using **Thief's Key**, **Silver Key**, and **Radiant Key** respectively, meaning that they control barriers to progression. * When **Chest Lock Randomization** was enabled, however, these chests would generate with a random level, causing a long-standing logic bug. * Now, these chests will always generate with their default level, ensuring logical accuracy.
## Fixes to Generation
* Do not create regions that will not be used in the rando (CodeTriangle/Archipelago#26, #92, @CodeTriangle). * This fixes a unit test failure.
## Fixes to Logic
* Move **Henry Trailblazing** to **Sapphire Ridge** region.
